verdict.rationale: Ramp's travel page says policy status is shown for every booking option, so trips aren't rejected later. It also documents per-diem limits that adjust by trip location and duration, and hotel rate monitoring with automatic rebooking, which shows in-platform hotel booking. The CLI separately lists 'book travel'. Flight booking is never named explicitly, and the evidence shows policy displayed at booking rather than enforced or blocked, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of in-platform flight booking, documentation that out-of-policy options are blocked or routed for approval at booking time, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, I can book flights and hotels in-platform with travel policy applied at booking time, not expensed and argued about later

citations.quote: See policy status for every option. No digging through static policy PDFs or wondering if trips will get rejected.
Per diem shows exactly what you can purchase, and automatically adjusts based on trip location and duration.
Ramp monitors hotel rates and automatically rebooks if the price decreases by $50+.
Authenticate with OAuth, manage expenses, approve bills, book travel, and more from your terminal or AI agent.
